safetyNotes: Official S7 page describes varied road/path hiking, easy stretches interrupted by narrow paths and up/down walking on eskers.
After Bollaltebygget the trail crosses a mire section that can be wet where there are no long boardwalks.
Road exposure occurs near the start around local roads N 567.01 and N 554, later around N 567/Prästgårdsvägen and central Knäred.
Krokån suspension bridge and Krokån watercourse are key features; no damage report found, but high water/ice can affect footing seasonally.
Dogs should be kept on lead; reserve rules strengthen this at Prästaskogen and Mästocka ljunghed, and Mästocka fenced areas have 1 Apr-1 Dec dog/horse restrictions.
Hunting may occur August-January; Hallandsleden general advice is to use bright clothing, stay on marked trail, keep dogs leashed and use arranged campsites.
Livestock/grazing animals are relevant around Bollaltebygget and Mästocka ljunghed; close gates, keep distance and keep dogs close.

sourceContradictions.details: Official page/API reports 17 km / 17000 m; GPX description reports 17.2 km; current GPX/API computed length is 17.183 km; Naturkartan/OSM/Wikiloc/Pacer report about 19-20 km for older Mästocka-Västralt structure.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Use 17 km as canonical display distance; keep computed/GPX 17.18/17.2 km for geometry QA; suppress 19-20 km as stale.

sourceContradictions.issue: Hallandsleden API line.geometry conflicts with official GPX/API geo_json
sourceContradictions.details: API geo_json and GPX match at 300 points and 17.183 km. API line.geometry is 833 points and 19.802 km, starting/ending far from the current official endpoints.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Use geo_json/GPX only. Suppress line.geometry until Hallandsleden corrects it or explains its semantics.

sourceContradictions.details: Naturkartan title has been updated to Mästocka - Knäred and page says the stage ends at Knäred bus stop, but slug remains mastocka-vastralt, length remains 19.0 km, and geometry remains overlong/reverse.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Use Naturkartan only as stale/partner context and not for import geometry/distance.

sourceContradictions.details: Official trail source calls the endpoint transit place Hållplats Knäred and lists bus 223. OSM labels the stop pair at the GPX endpoint as Smedjebacken, with another Knäred stop about 317 m away.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Import official trail access place and/or OSM Smedjebacken as the exact stop area, with naming caveat. Do not treat this as an endpoint conflict.

sourceContradictions.details: Hallandsleden says Krokån toilet is open year-round and that water bottles can be filled there. Naturkartan local-loop context may indicate seasonal toilet access for nearby facilities.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Import Krokån water/toilet with high confidence from Hallandsleden but add a verify-outside-season/currentness note before public guarantee.

sourceContradictions.details: Official current S7 is blue/medium. Naturkartan stale page mentions a steep final stretch up to Västralt, which may apply to the old continuation beyond current Knäred endpoint rather than S7 core.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Use official medium/blue and current official route difficulty text; keep Västralt steep note only in adjacent/legacy context.

researchIterations.mainThreadBaseline: Checked official page/GPX/API/places, Naturkartan page/API/GPX, OSM route/access/facility data, adjacent S6/S8 continuity and Länsstyrelsen Prästaskogen/Bollaltebygget/Mästocka context.
researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Strong enough for section JSON after the first six-lane batch. Remaining issues are documented import caveats rather than missing source coverage: stale geometry suppression, Västralt/Gula villan side modeling, Mästocka access limitations, Krokån water currentness and protected-area boundary verification.

openQuestions: Before normalization, ask Hallandsleden or inspect source semantics for why API line.geometry and Naturkartan still expose the old 19.8 km Mästocka-Västralt line while GPX/API geo_json has the current 17.18 km Mästocka-Knäred route.
Before import, decide how to model Västralt and Gula villan: S8 context, side-service connection from Knäred, legacy continuation metadata, or suppression from S7 core.
Before import, decide whether Knäred endpoint transit should use official Hållplats Knäred naming, OSM Smedjebacken stop/platform naming, or both with stop-normalization.

Before public access guidance, verify the closer Mästocka local parking at 56.605909,13.247510 and the walking connection to the official GPX start; Mästocka ljunghed official parking is stronger but about 0.55 km away.
Before publication/use, verify Hallandstrafiken line 223/325 service patterns, stop names and seasonal/timetable changes for the target date.
Before import, verify Krokån water/toilet year-round access outside main season and decide whether to mark Krokån water as potable/year-round, toilet-water refill, or conditional.
Before final rules copy, run final GIS overlay for Bollaltebygget, Prästaskogen, Mästocka ljunghed and Knäreds VV against the exact GPX chosen for import.
Before publication/use, recheck active Hallandsleden notices, Laholm fire-ban/risk status, Länsstyrelsen reserve pages, forestry notifications and the Markarydsbanan/Knäred project currentness.
Before import, verify current operation/opening hours for Coop Knäred, Hotell 1613/Freden, Knäreds Pizzeria and Flammabadets camping if any commercial records are normalized.

If navigation-grade turn detail is required, review the 300-point official GPX around road crossings, boardwalks/wetland after Bollaltebygget and Krokån bridge while preserving official GPX provenance.
Do not attach local AllTrails overgrowth/noise reports to the whole S7 unless a field/source pass confirms they are on the Hallandsleden line rather than nearby Knäred loops.
Track Laholm Västralt 1:8 solar-park planning only as future adjacent/legacy route risk unless it becomes an official S7/S8 closure or reroute.

importReadiness.identity: ready: canonical official identity is Mästocka - Knäred, Södra delleden section 7 / official order 23, 17 km, medium/blue, no official walking time.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From the Mästocka/Björsjön endpoint the trail heads south through a varied mix of small roads, older paths, eskers and wetland sections toward Killebergssjön, Mejeribacken and Bollaltebygget. After cultural traces such as the old stone bridge, rullstensås and Dödsröset, the route crosses Krokån into Prästaskogen, where shelter, toilet, water refill and picnic facilities sit near the mill area. The section finishes at Knäred bus stop, with grocery, food and lodging services close by.
importReadiness.geometry: ready with caveats: official GPX/API geo_json is canonical 300-point navigation-grade geometry; Hallandsleden line.geometry, Naturkartan and OSM relation 7396989 are stale/overlong and must be suppressed.
importReadiness.endpoints: ready with caveats: Mästocka/Björsjön start stitches to S6 within about 0.89 m and Knäred endpoint stitches to S8 within about 5.34 m; decide stop naming for Hållplats Knäred/Smedjebacken.
importReadiness.commuteAccess: ready with caveats: Knäred endpoint transit is strong; Mästocka public transit is weak/remote and should be modeled as parking/pickup/continuation access unless later live transit research improves it.
importReadiness.facilities: ready with caveats: core official facilities are sourced and coordinate-checked; side/connection records at Västralt, Gula villan and Flammabadet need policy filtering; Mästocka shared endpoint records should be deduped.
importReadiness.water: ready with seasonality/currentness caveats: Mästocka water is seasonal 15 Apr-15 Oct; Krokån water refill is official but should be verified outside season; Bollaltebygget has no water.
importReadiness.campingFire: ready with boundary/dynamic caveats: Mästocka and Krokån are core official camps/shelters; Västralt/Flammabadet are side/connection context; Bollaltebygget no-fire/no-camping and Prästaskogen designated-fire rules must be respected.
importReadiness.rulesSafety: ready with dynamic caveats: import Bollaltebygget and Prästaskogen protected-area rules, Mästocka ljunghed adjacent caution, fire/dog/hunting/livestock/wetland/road/bridge/forestry/currentness notes; recheck live notices before publication.
importReadiness.fieldReports: usable: no active closure/reroute found; recent local Knäred/Krokån/Prästaskogen signals are generally good/maintained; stale Mästocka-Västralt sources documented.
doNotImportYet: Do not integrate into runtime app data.
Do not use Hallandsleden line.geometry as S7 geometry.
Do not use Naturkartan or OSM relation 7396989 as full S7 geometry.
Do not use Mästocka - Västralt or 19-20 km distances as current canonical S7 data.
Do not mark Mästocka as directly transit-accessible without strong caveats.
Do not import Gula villan, Västralt or Flammabadet as core S7 facilities without side-service/connection policy.
Do not treat Knäred bus shelters as hiking shelters.
Do not promise Krokån water as year-round/potable without final currentness verification.
Do not generalize local Knäred-loop overgrowth/noise reviews to the whole S7 route.
